memory_candidates.content: Over Z-time, regular frames with a finite world-state carrier cannot satisfy box(p or Fp or Pp) and box(p -> not Pp): every history meets p at most once, and a finite carrier forces a p-free cycle that is itself a history. So no certificate class presenting a finite-carrier frame (FrameOver.ofStep on Fin n) is complete for Z-time non-validity, for L or L-plus; a complete class must present an infinite, finitely presented (eventually periodic, time-stamped) carrier, as the landed L witness family does.

For L-plus over Z-frames the two-sided stability modal factors into one-sided universal path conditions: for all pairs (past, future), OR over origin types of (past-run and future-run) is equivalent to AND over origin types of ((no past run) or (no future run)), because forall rho forall sigma (P rho or Q sigma) is (forall rho P) or (forall sigma Q). This is why live = fwdLive ∩ bwdLive is the right shape and why past operators do not raise complexity above CTL*.
